Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for claim review purposes. Can you please
state your full name for the record?
A: Yes, I'm the claimant. You have my name on file already, so I'll just say I'm the driver of the vehicle that was
rear-ended.
Q: Understood. Can you walk me through what happened at the time of the collision?
A: I was stopped at a light on a main road in Pearland, Texas, waiting for the signal to change. I had come to a
complete stop when I felt a hard impact from behind. My head snapped back and then forward, and my seatbelt
locked up.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I checked my mirror a moment before, but the car behind me was a bit further back. I didn't have time to
react after that.
Q: Were you able to get out of your vheicle at the scene?
A: Yes, I got out, but I felt dizzy and stiff. The other driver was apologetic and we exchanged information. A police
officer came out and filed a report.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same day and was later referred to a physical therapist. I have neck pain
that radiates into my shoulders, and I get headaches, mostly in the afternoon. Turning my head to check blind spots is
painful.
Q: Are you still experiencing those symptoms now?
A: Yes, they're improving slowly, but I still have stiffness in the morning and I've had to cut back on driving longer
distances.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: No, I think that covers it. I'm willing to provide my medical records and the report number from the officer.
Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
